integrity: Analytic proof by spherical moment identities, fourth-Wasserstein contraction and stationary moment equations; reproducibility code is supplemental; no independent scientific audit has occurred.
limitations: Independently renewed Haar unit rows and independent scalar responses with finite fourth moment; fixed noisy linear systems, anisotropic rows and Gaussian distributional convergence are not included.
title: Exact fourth-cumulant attenuation and mixing cost for isotropic noisy Kaczmarz
